{{Top|leg}}
A '''pain simulator''' was a device that allowed [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to feel pain, emitting high-frequency carrier waves so that other droids could also experience pain. The droid [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] often used this device for [[Torture/Legends|torture]] sessions.
